financeStories.originalTitle: Why AI is both the hope and the hazard for world leaders, according to IMF chief Georgieva
financeStories.stance: 国际资本与华尔街视角
financeStories.snippet: Kristalina Georgieva warns that the technology lifting growth hopes is also pushing up inflation and yields, just as public debt levels rose.
financeStories.fullContent:
SINGAPORE — The technology that investors and governments are counting on to lift the global economy is also adding pressure that threatens growth, the head of the International Monetary Fund said, urging policymakers to stop delaying painful choices on debt.

Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva told the audience at a Wednesday event in Singapore that artificial intelligence is "rapidly becoming a key driver of countries' relative fortunes in the world economy."

But the triple forces of AI advancement, soaring energy costs and record public debt are challenging the already "underwhelming" growth this decade.

"Love it, hate it, or fear it, AI is here," Georgieva said.

Speaking ahead of a series of IMF and World Bank annual meetings that kick off next week, Georgieva framed the global economy as being tugged in two directions at once: a "negative energy supply shock" from the war in the Gulf, now in its eighth month, and a "positive demand shock" from the AI investment boom. The combined effect, she said, is "highly uneven across the world."

On the upside, global AI investment as a share of GDP will reach, and likely exceed, the amounts that went into building the railroads, electricity grid, or telecommunications network. AI hardware and related technology products already account for more than a tenth of world goods trade, she said.

The IMF estimates that AI could add up to half a percentage point to annual world growth if done right. "Going from 3% to 3.5% over a decade — that is like adding an economy the size of ASEAN to the world economy," Georgieva said.

But the benefits are likely highly concentrated. The boom largely bypasses economies less involved in the global AI supply chain, "increasing the risk of widening economic inequality across the globe," she said.

The boom also feeds the inflation worry that has dogged policymakers from the U.S. to Europe and Asia. "The AI building boom is inflationary," she said, as are energy and food shocks, tariffs and defense spending.

Oil prices have stayed above $100 per barrel as the Middle East conflict dragged on with few signs of a diplomatic off-ramp. Retail diesel prices also rose to record highs as refining capacity squeezed energy supplies.

That inflation pressure flows straight into bond markets, as bond yields in the U.S., Germany, and Japan have surged to their highest levels in decades. Ballooning long-term private bond issuance by AI-related borrowers also competes with governments for capital, although part of the rise may reflect expectations of faster growth, Georgieva said.

Global public debt is near its highest level since World War II and on track to soon exceed 100% of GDP, with advanced economies the "worst offenders," Georgieva said. For 17 years, governments had "a relatively easy ride" because interest rates stayed below growth rates. "Higher interest rates now put an end to that."

The interest-to-growth differential is now "much less favourable" and "set to climb higher," she said, which means the growth needed to reduce debt ratios without fiscal effort is now "out of reach in the near term."

The strain is already visible in Europe, where spreads over German bunds are widening not just for France and Italy but for Ireland, Portugal and others that had reduced debt and deficits after the euro-area crisis.

After a string of shocks that have ballooned public debt and most countries' fiscal deficits remained above pre-pandemic averages, "fiscal space is crying out for replenishment," Georgieva said.

Georgieva also pointed to a financial stability risk in the AI boom itself. Strong corporate earnings are driving share prices and wealth effects, she said, but "should earnings fall short, however, hyperscaler leverage and large and growing global holdings of U.S. equities could turn a disappointment into a far-reaching shock."

Citing Amara's Law, which holds that people overestimate a new technology in the short run and underestimate it in the long run, she said it is "somewhere in the transition between today's AI building boom and tomorrow's arrival of AI's benefits that we will traverse the period of maximum risk."

Georgieva said the first line of defense is regulation and supervision. "Now may be a good time for a prudently hawkish bias in many countries' monetary policy," she said.

新加坡——国际货币基金组织（IMF）总裁表示，投资者和各国政府寄予厚望以提振全球经济的这项技术，同时也正在带来威胁增长的压力；她敦促政策制定者不要再推迟在债务问题上做出痛苦抉择。

IMF总裁克里斯塔利娜·格奥尔基耶娃（Kristalina Georgieva）周三在新加坡的一场活动中对现场观众表示，人工智能“正迅速成为决定各国在全球经济中相对命运的关键驱动力”。

然而，人工智能的飞速发展、飙升的能源成本以及创纪录的公共债务这三重力量，正在对本十年本已“差强人意”的增长构成挑战。

“不论你喜欢、讨厌还是畏惧它，人工智能都已然来临，”格奥尔基耶娃说道。

在下周即将拉开帷幕的IMF与世界银行年会前夕发表演讲时，格奥尔基耶娃将全球经济描述为正同时受到两个相反方向的拉扯：一方面是已进入第八个月的海湾地区战事带来的“负面能源供应冲击”，另一方面则是人工智能投资热潮带来的“正面需求冲击”。她指出，两者的综合影响“在全球范围内极不均衡”。

从积极的一面来看，全球人工智能投资占GDP的比重将达到、甚至可能超过昔日建设铁路、电网或电信网络的投资规模。她表示，人工智能硬件及相关科技产品目前已占全球货物贸易的十分之一以上。

IMF估计，如果运用得当，人工智能每年可为全球经济增长贡献多达0.5个百分点。格奥尔基耶娃说：“十年内让增长率从3%提升到3.5%——这相当于为全球经济增加了一个相当于东盟（ASEAN）规模的经济体。”

但这些红利很可能高度集中。她表示，这股繁荣热潮在很大程度上绕过了那些较少参与全球人工智能供应链的经济体，“加剧了全球经济不平等扩大的风险”。

这股热潮还加剧了长期困扰从美欧美到亚洲各国政策制定者的通胀担忧。“人工智能的建设热潮具有推高通胀的属性，”她表示，能源与食品冲击、关税以及国防开支同样如此。

随着中东冲突持续蔓延且鲜有外交斡旋缓和的迹象，石油价格一直维持在每桶100美元以上。炼油产能受限导致能源供应紧张，零售柴油价格也飙升至历史新高。

这种通胀压力直接传导至债券市场，美国、德国和日本的债券收益率已飙升至数十年来的最高水平。格奥尔基耶娃指出，人工智能相关借款人发行的长期民间债券急剧膨胀，也与政府争夺资金，尽管收益率的部分上升可能反映了对更快增长的预期。

格奥尔基耶娃表示，全球公共债务正逼近二战以来的最高水平，并有望很快突破GDP的100%，其中发达经济体是“首要元凶”。在过去的17年里，由于利率始终低于经济增速，各国政府度过了“一段相对轻松的时光”。“如今更高的利率给这种局面画上了句号。”

她表示，利率与经济增长率之差如今“更加不利”且“还将进一步走高”，这意味着在不付出财政努力的情况下仅靠增长来降低债务率的目标，目前在“短期内已遥不可及”。

欧洲已经显现出这种紧张态势，不仅法国和意大利相对于德国国债的利差在扩大，爱尔兰、葡萄牙等在欧元区危机后曾缩减债务和赤字的国家也是如此。

格奥尔基耶娃表示，在一连串推高公共债务的冲击之后，大多数国家的财政赤字仍高于疫情前平均水平，“财政空间迫切需要得到补充”。

格奥尔基耶娃还指出了人工智能热潮本身潜藏的金融稳定风险。她表示，强劲的企业盈利正在推高股价并带来财富效应，但“如果企业盈利不及预期，超大规模云服务商（hyperscaler）的杠杆率以及全球对美股庞大且不断增长的持仓，可能会使失望情绪演变为一场影响深远的冲击”。

她引用了阿马拉定律（Amara's Law）——该定律认为人们短期内往往高估一项新技术，而在长期内又会低估它——并指出：“正是在当今人工智能建设热潮与未来人工智能效益真正显现之间的过渡期，我们将经历风险最高的一段时期。”

格奥尔基耶娃表示，第一道防线是监管与监督。她说：“现在或许是许多国家在货币政策上保持审慎鹰派倾向的好时机。”

financeStories.fullContent: Brent Crude oil prices have held above $100 per barrel for most of the past month despite numerous reports and figures put out in recent weeks by tanker-tracking services and investment banks that crude oil flows from the Strait of Hormuz have recovered, and even exceeded, pre-war levels. But if so much crude is leaving the Middle East again, why do Brent prices continue to hover around the $100 a barrel mark, up from $60 before the war The Perfect Storm Because crude oil flows returning to pre-war levels does not mean that the market has returned to normal. Far from it. The price of getting the oil out of the Middle East is astronomically high, with freight rates at record highs. War risk premiums have jumped as tankers continue to be attacked in the Strait of Hormuz. Gulf producers have found workarounds to crude flows with alternative routes, which are less efficient, cost buyers more, and take additional weeks to bring crude supply to refiners. Refiners, for their part, are scrambling to keep processing rates high to seize the record-high refining margins and produce more diesel, which remains the most stressed barrel of oil. Fuel exports from the Middle East are still limited, Russia's are non-existent because of Moscow's ban on diesel shipments, and China is once again protecting domestic supply and curbing fuel flows overseas. In addition, global inventories have crashed this year as the immediate relief to peak Strait of Hormuz disruptions in April and May was to draw down from crude and fuel stocks. Inventories, therefore, are so thin that they may not be able to offset another escalation in the U.S.-Iran war. These are only the operational issues the global markets face ahead of the winter diesel peak demand season. The geopolitical situation is the biggest unknown for oil prices going forward, and it doesn't look like the war is ending soon. Instead, the market fears fresh escalations either before or after the U.S. midterm elections in early November, which could threaten the recovery of oil flows from the Strait of Hormuz. Related Gulf Storm Threat Could Put 3 Million Bpd of Refining Capacity at Risk With markets depleted of sizeable cushions to absorb new shocks, crude oil prices continue to price in an elevated war risk premium, keeping Brent above $100 per barrel since early September. "A sustained move lower in Brent requires broader normalisation improving crude supply, recovering product exports and reduced political and financial risks to shipping," Ole Hansen, Head of Commodity Strategy at Saxo Bank, said last week, commenting on the prospect of stocks release. The G7 group on Friday announced the release of 100 million of crude oil and diesel stocks. After an initial knee-jerk reaction lower, Brent remains at above $100 per barrel in Asian trade on Tuesday. The effect of the release announcement on oil prices seems to have faded, also because the market is not really certain how many of the 100 million barrels would be really "new", or if they are the remainder of the IEA's pledge to release 425 million barrels months ago, part of which were never actually released, Bjarne Schieldrop, chief analyst commodities at SEB Bank, said on Monday. The analyst also noted that while the Brent front-month futures price is about $100 per barrel, the price of North Sea's Oseberg and Fortis crudes is actually about $140 a barrel. The Upside Risks Key unknowns are keeping the front-month Brent futures at $100, according to SEB. "Will Iran initiate fresh attacks before the US midterm elections Will the US attack Iran after the elections Will the US be able to keep the SoH close to open at 17.5 mb/d Will the Houthis re-attack the Saudi east-west pipeline and ships trying to traverse the Bab-el Mandeb Strait as the Saudi-backed Yemen government tries to retake areas along the Red Sea recently taken by the Houthis," Schieldrop says, also asking, "How far will this have to go before China finally decides to step in as a peacemaker in ME negotiations" Despite claims of return to pre-war levels of Middle East crude oil exports, the risk to oil prices is currently tilted to the upside amid the potential of escalation, record-high freight and war premium tanker rates, very low global inventory, and the diesel crisis compounded by the lack of exports from the Middle East and Russia. "The market is pricing not only how much crude is being loaded, but also whether these barrels can be delivered safely, reliably, and at low cost," Xuyi Zhao, senior oil analyst at Guotai Junan Futures, told Bloomberg. The higher cost of getting crude to refiners and low inventories unable to offset another near-term disruption set the stage for a new price spike if another crude supply route in the Middle East is attacked, as was the case with Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline to the Red Sea last month. Saudi Aramco's CEO Amin Nasser said earlier this week, "With precious little else the world can turn to, the supply resilience cushion is scarily thin." "Emergency reserves might buy us a winter. They cannot fix long-term supply," Nasser said at the 2026 Energy Intelligence Forum in London on Monday. "Until Hormuz fully re-opens and confidence returns, the crude reality is that pressure at both ends of the barrel will intensify." By Tsvetana Paraskova for Oilprice.com
financeStories.fullTranslation:
在过去一个月的大部分时间里，布伦特原油价格一直保持在每桶100美元以上。尽管油轮跟踪服务机构和投资银行近几周发布了大量报告和数据，表明霍尔木兹海峡的原油运量已经恢复甚至超过了战前水平，但如果从中东运出的原油量再次增加，为什么布伦特油价仍继续徘徊在每桶100美元左右，远高于战前的60美元？

完美风暴

因为原油运量恢复到战前水平，并不意味着市场已经恢复正常。事实远非如此。将石油运出中东的代价极其高昂，运费创下历史新高。随着霍尔木兹海峡的油轮持续遭到袭击，战争风险溢价大幅攀升。海湾产油国找到了替代路线来维持原油运输，但这些路线效率较低、买家成本更高，并且需要额外数周时间才能将原油供应运抵炼油厂。

炼油厂方面则在争分夺秒地保持高开工率，以抓住创纪录的高炼油利润，并生产更多的柴油——柴油仍然是成品油中供应最为紧张的品种。来自中东的燃料出口依然受限，由于莫斯科对柴油出口下达禁令，俄罗斯的出口量基本为零，而中国则再次保护国内供应并限制燃油向海外流动。此外，今年全球库存出现暴跌，因为在4月和5月应对霍尔木兹海峡中断高峰期的直接手段就是消耗原油和燃料库存。因此，库存极为薄弱，以至于可能无法抵御美伊战争的另一次升级。

这些仅是全球市场在冬季柴油需求高峰季节来临前所面临的运营问题。地缘政治局势是未来油价面临的最大未知数，而且看起来这场战争不会很快结束。相反，市场担忧在11月初美国中期选举之前或之后局势会进一步升级，这可能会威胁到霍尔木兹海峡原油运量的恢复。

相关报道：海湾风暴威胁可能令每日300万桶炼油产能面临风险

由于市场缺乏能够吸收新冲击的充足缓冲，原油价格继续计入高昂的战争风险溢价，自9月初以来一直将布伦特原油支撑在每桶100美元上方。盛宝银行（Saxo Bank）大宗商品策略主管奥勒·汉森（Ole Hansen）上周在评论储备释放前景时表示：“布伦特油价要实现持续下跌，需要更广泛的正常化——原油供应改善、成品油出口恢复，以及航运的政治和金融风险降低。”

G7集团于周五宣布释放1亿桶原油和柴油储备。在经历了最初下意识的下跌反应后，周二亚洲交易时段布伦特油价仍保持在每桶100美元上方。SEB银行大宗商品首席分析师比亚内·希尔德罗普（Bjarne Schieldrop）周一表示，释放储备声明对油价的影响似乎已经消退，部分原因也是因为市场并不确定这1亿桶储备中有多少是真正的“增量”，抑或是几个月前国际能源署（IEA）承诺释放的4.25亿桶储备中从未实际释放的剩余部分。该分析师还指出，尽管布伦特近月期货价格约为每桶100美元，但北海的奥斯伯格（Oseberg）和福蒂斯（Forties）原油价格实际上已达每桶140美元左右。

上行风险

根据SEB的说法，核心的不确定因素令布伦特近月期货价格维持在100美元。希尔德罗普称：“伊朗会在美国中期选举前发起新的袭击吗？美国会在选举后对伊朗发动攻击吗？美国能否将霍尔木兹海峡的运量维持在接近每天1750万桶的开放状态？随着沙特支持的也门政府试图夺回胡塞武装最近占领的红海沿岸地区，胡塞武装是否会再次袭击沙特东西管道以及试图穿越曼德海峡的船只？”他还问道，“这种情况还要持续多久，中国才会最终决定作为和平调停人介入中东谈判？”

尽管有关于中东原油出口恢复到战前水平的说法，但在局势升级的潜在风险、创纪录的运费与油轮战险溢价、极低的全球库存，以及中东和俄罗斯出口匮乏加剧的柴油危机共同作用下，目前油价风险仍然偏向上行。

国泰君安期货高级原油分析师赵旭一（音译，Xuyi Zhao）对彭博社表示：“市场不仅在对装运了多少原油进行定价，而且在对这些原油能否安全、可靠且低成本地送达进行定价。”将原油运往炼油厂的更高成本以及无法抵消下一次短期中断的低库存，为中东另一条原油供应路线遇袭时引发新一轮价格暴涨埋下了伏笔，正如上个月沙特阿拉伯通往红海的东西管道所遭遇的情况一样。

沙特阿美（Saudi Aramco）首席执行官阿明·纳赛尔（Amin Nasser）本周早些时候表示：“在世界上几乎没有其他供应可求助的情况下，供应弹性的缓冲空间薄弱得令人担忧。”纳赛尔周一在伦敦举行的2026年能源情报论坛（Energy Intelligence Forum）上说：“应急储备或许能为我们争取一个冬天的时间，但它们无法解决长期供应问题。在霍尔木兹海峡完全重新开放且信心恢复之前，残酷的现实是，原油桶两端所面临的压力都会进一步加剧。”

作者：Tsvetana Paraskova，为 Oilprice.com 撰稿

financeStories.title: 图表：标普500指数创下新高的非凡与逆势之旅
financeStories.originalTitle: Chart: A look at the S&P 500's remarkable and defiant trip to a new record
financeStories.stance: 国际资本与华尔街视角
financeStories.source: CNBC Markets (CNBC 市场官方英文)
financeStories.snippet: The S&P 500 returned to an intraday record Tuesday as tech gains, easing oil prices and Treasury yields helped stocks overcome months of market shocks.
financeStories.fullContent:
The S&P 500 rose to an all-time intraday on Tuesday, touching 7844.52 and surpassing its August 13 intraday peak when it hit 7,830. The benchmark also closed for the first time over 7,800.

The recovery comes after months of oil shocks, rising borrowing costs and the possible start of a Federal Reserve rate hiking cycle.

The record rally comes just a day after the 10-year Treasury yield surpassed 5.3%, reaching levels not seen since 2002. In mid September, the Fed raised its benchmark rate for the first time in over three years and indicated more were to come.

Oil had crossed $100 a barrel in early March for the first time since 2022 as the Iran conflict disrupted energy supplies moving through the Strait of Hormuz. After falling below $70 a barrel, it slingshot back above $100 in early September.

"At the end of the day, oil and bond yields can be correlated, but so is the stock market and profits. And if the profits are there, which they have been, the stock market is going to be resilient, even if the economy is a bit more mixed," Shawn Snyder, economic strategist at Potomac Fund Management, told CNBC.

Unlike prior records this year, this latest run has been narrowly lead by a few stocks tied to the AI hype and deemed unfettered by adverse macroeconomic headwinds.

"When traders take a breather from the noise surrounding them — much of it negative in recent months — and look closer at what's happening in the markets, it becomes clear the U.S. stock market is the best place to park their money compared with other locations. It's hard to argue against the mostly positive risk-reward ratio we've seen over multiple decades," said JJ Kinahan, Cboe Global Markets senior vice president of retail and alternative investments.

The so-called Magnificent 7 namely, Nvidia, Alphabet, Amazon, Apple, Meta, Microsoft and Tesla make up more than 34% of the market cap of the S&P 500.

"When you consider that much girth among a small handful of stocks, it's apparent how much these stocks' daily movements dictate the direction of the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq, both of which are in record territory again today," Kinahan said.

With tech companies investing heavily in data centers and computing infrastructure demand for chips and equipment has gone up. Earlier this year, Amazon said it expected about $200 billion in capital expenditures across its businesses in 2026, citing opportunities including AI, chips and robotics.

Investor appetite for ambitious technology bets also became evident in June, when SpaceX raised $75 billion in the largest IPO ever and began trading on June 12. The debut became another milestone where investors continued backing growth companies despite higher energy prices and borrowing costs.

Looking ahead, however, Potomac Fund Management's Snyder cautioned that the "weakening" market breadth may last longer if inflation shows no signs of easing, or if there's no clear signal that the Federal Reserve is achieving its mandate. The central bank is slated to release its minutes from the September meeting on Wednesday.

The market "can look relatively calm, but there are still things going on underneath the surface that may not be so calm," Snyder said.

Correction: The 10-year Treasury yield on Monday surpassed 5.3% to reach highs not seen since 2002. An earlier version misstated the year.

financeStories.fullTranslation:
标普500指数周二盘中升至历史新高，触及7844.52点，超越了8月13日创下的7830点盘中峰值。该基准指数还首次收于7800点上方。

此次反弹是在经历了数月的石油冲击、借贷成本上升以及美联储可能开启加息周期之后出现的。

就在创纪录大涨的前一天，10年期美债收益率刚刚突破5.3%，达到2002年以来未见的水平。9月中旬，美联储进行了三年多以来的首次基准利率上调，并暗示未来还将进一步加息。

今年3月初，由于伊朗冲突扰乱了经由霍尔木兹海峡运输的能源供应，原油价格自2022年以来首次突破每桶100美元。在跌破每桶70美元后，油价于9月初再次大幅反弹至100美元上方。

波托马克基金管理公司（Potomac Fund Management）经济策略师肖恩·斯奈德（Shawn Snyder）向CNBC表示：“归根结底，石油和债券收益率可能具有相关性，但股市与企业盈利也是如此。如果盈利依然存在——而事实确实如此——那么即使整体经济形势更加错综复杂，股市仍将保持韧性。”

与今年早些时候创下的纪录不同，最近这轮涨势主要由少数几只与人工智能热潮紧密挂钩、且被认为未受宏观经济逆风影响的股票狭窄拉动。

芝加哥期权交易所全球市场（Cboe Global Markets）零售与另类投资高级副总裁JJ·基纳汉（JJ Kinahan）表示：“当交易员从身边的嘈杂声（近几个月大多是负面情绪）中抽身并更深入地观察市场时，他们就会清楚地发现，与其他市场相比，美股是停放资金的最佳场所。面对数十年来我们所见证的基本积极的风险回报比，人们很难提出反驳。”

所谓的“七巨头”（Magnificent 7）——即英伟达、Alphabet、亚马逊、苹果、Meta、微软和特斯拉——目前占据标普500指数总市值的34%以上。

基纳汉说：“当你考虑到少数几只股票就拥有如此巨大的体量时，就会清楚地意识到它们的日常波动在多大程度上决定了标普500指数和纳斯达克指数的走势，而这两大指数今天双双再次进入历史新高区间。”

随着科技公司在数据中心和计算基础设施方面投入巨资，对芯片和设备的需求也水涨船高。今年早些时候，亚马逊表示，鉴于人工智能、芯片和机器人等领域的机遇，其预计2026年全业务范围内的资本支出约为2000亿美元。

投资者对雄心勃勃的科技押注的热情在6月份也表现得淋漓尽致，当时SpaceX完成了史上最大规模的IPO，募资750亿美元，并于6月12日开始挂牌交易。这一上市首秀成为另一个里程碑，表明即使面临更高的能源价格和借贷成本，投资者依然在继续支持成长型企业。

然而展望未来，波托马克基金管理公司的斯奈德警告称，如果通胀没有缓解迹象，或者没有明确信号表明美联储正在达成其政策目标，那么市场广度的“减弱”可能会持续更长时间。美联储定于周三公布9月会议纪要。

斯奈德表示，市场“表面看起来可能相对平静，但在水面之下仍潜伏着可能并不那么风平浪静的事情”。

更正：周一10年期美债收益率突破5.3%，创下2002年以来的最高水平。此前的版本曾误报了年份。

financeStories.title: Spotify将有声读物服务扩展至180多个市场
financeStories.originalTitle: Spotify expands audiobooks to over 180 markets
financeStories.snippet: Spotify will make 350,000 titles available in over 120 languages for this expansion
financeStories.fullContent:
Spotify announced on Wednesday that it’s expanding audiobook access to over 180 markets worldwide, including regions across Europe, the Americas, the Caribbean, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia. The rollout is starting today and will continue over the coming months. With this move, more than 750 million users will be able to access audiobooks, allowing Spotify to better compete with both music streaming providers and audiobook apps like Audible.

Before this, audiobooks were available primarily in English-speaking markets like the U.S., U.K., Ireland, Australia, and New Zealand, as well as in Germany.

The audio platform said it has more than 350,000 titles for its new markets and has increased its collection to include over 120 languages. With its launch in Spain, users in the country will have access to over 45,000 titles in Spanish.

Spotify is working with more than 300 publishers worldwide, including Planeta and Mondadori, to increase the number of titles available in different markets.

With a Premium subscription, users can listen to 12 hours of audiobooks in eligible countries such as Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Poland, Chile, Norway, and Peru. People across the world can also purchase an Audiobook+ standalone subscription to get access to titles with a 15-hour allowance. Alternatively, users can buy individual titles directly.

In February, the company launched a “Page Match” feature, which lets users scan a page of a physical book and find the corresponding point in the audiobook to listen to. Since the launch, 1 million people have been using the feature monthly, the company noted.

Spotify said that over the last year, monthly listeners of audiobooks grew by 40% and listening hours increased by 30%.

This year, the company introduced Audiobook Charts to let people discover popular titles. It also launched an AI-powered tool for authors to turn their books into audiobooks using models from ElevenLabs. Plus, Spotify started experimenting with physical sales of books through its audiobook platform in select markets like the U.S. and the U.K.

Spotify周三宣布，将把有声读物服务扩展至全球180多个市场，包括欧洲、美洲、加勒比地区、中东、非洲和亚洲的多个地区。这项推广从今天开始，并将在未来几个月持续进行。此举实施后，将有超过7.5亿用户能够使用有声读物，帮助Spotify更好地与音乐流媒体服务商以及Audible等有声读物应用展开竞争。

此前，有声读物主要面向美国、英国、爱尔兰、澳大利亚和新西兰等英语市场，以及德国市场提供。

这家音频平台表示，已为新市场准备了超过35万部作品，并将其藏书扩展至包含120多种语言。随着Spotify在西班牙推出服务，该国用户将可以使用超过4.5万部西班牙语作品。

Spotify正与全球300多家出版商合作，包括Planeta和Mondadori，以增加不同市场可用的作品数量。

在符合条件的巴西、墨西哥、哥伦比亚、波兰、智利、挪威和秘鲁等国家，用户通过Premium订阅可收听12小时有声读物。全球各地的用户还可以单独购买Audiobook+订阅，以获得包含15小时额度的服务。此外，用户也可以直接购买单部作品。

今年2月，公司推出了“Page Match”功能，用户可以扫描实体书中的一页，找到有声读物中对应的位置并开始收听。公司指出，自该功能推出以来，每月已有100万人使用。

Spotify表示，在过去一年中，有声读物的月度听众数量增长了40%，收听时长增加了30%。

今年，公司推出了有声读物榜单，帮助用户发现热门作品。公司还推出了一款由人工智能驱动的工具，利用ElevenLabs的模型帮助作者将书籍制作成有声读物。此外，Spotify还开始在美国和英国等部分市场试验通过其有声读物平台销售实体书。

financeStories.title: 花瓣“天窗”影响花朵内部微生物丰度
financeStories.originalTitle: Petal 'windows' affect the abundance of microbes within flowers
financeStories.snippet: Some flowers have petals with small semitranslucent sections. Research in New Phytologist reveals that these "windows" alter the amount of light and heat entering the flower and create conditions that influence microbial abundance.
financeStories.fullContent:
edited by Sadie Harley, reviewed by Robert Egan

This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies. Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

peer-reviewed publication

Some flowers have petals with small semitranslucent sections. Research in New Phytologist reveals that these "windows" alter the amount of light and heat entering the flower and create conditions that influence microbial abundance.

Field experiments showed that petal windows transmitted more ultraviolet and infrared radiation than pigmented tissue. Also, internal floral temperature predicted microbial numbers, with warmer flowers harboring fewer microbes.

Because microbial communities that live inside flowers can affect nectar quality, this discovery indicates that petal windows may influence how pollinators interact with flowers.

"One of the exciting things about this work is that a seemingly small floral trait can change the physical environment inside a flower in ways that affect its microbial community," said corresponding author Jessica Williams, a Ph.D. student at Florida Atlantic University.

"Because floral microbes can influence nectar traits and plant-pollinator interactions, these results suggest that flower structure may have ecological consequences that extend beyond the flower itself."

Petal infrared transmission warms flowers and reduces microbial abundance, New Phytologist (2026). DOI: 10.1111/nph.71608

Journal information: New Phytologist

一些花朵的花瓣上具有微小的半透明区域。发表在《新植物学家》（New Phytologist）上的一项研究揭示，这些“天窗”会改变进入花朵的光线和热量，并创造出影响微生物丰度的环境条件。
野外实验表明，与有色组织相比，花瓣天窗能透射更多的紫外线和红外线辐射。此外，花内温度可以预测微生物数量，温度较高的花朵所含微生物较少。
由于生活在花朵内部的微生物群落能够影响花蜜品质，这一发现表明花瓣天窗可能会影响传粉者与花朵的相互作用方式。
“这项工作令人兴奋的要点之一在于，一个看似微小的花部特征可以改变花内物理环境，进而影响其微生物群落，”通讯作者、佛罗里达大西洋大学（Florida Atlantic University）博士生杰西卡·威廉姆斯（Jessica Williams）表示。
“由于花内微生物能影响花蜜特征以及植物与传粉者的相互作用，这些结果表明花朵结构所产生的生态效应可能会延伸至花朵本身之外。”

Posts from this topic will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

Solutions to ‘hundreds’ of open questions are said to be included in a batch of manuscripts released by OpenAI.

Posts from this author will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

See All by Robert Hart

OpenAI has revealed solutions to a number of long-standing mathematics problems produced by an unreleased frontier model in a batch of 722 manuscripts, covering 372 result families that group related papers. It extends a run of breakthroughs that have both impressed and unsettled parts of the mathematical community while raising questions about research ethics and academic conduct. According to AGMAI, the newly formed independent advisory group of elite mathematicians put together to work on communicating the results responsibly, the release includes solutions to “hundreds” of open questions.

The results have been expected for weeks, although until now OpenAI had not provided details about which problems the model had solved or exactly when they would be published. In September, the company said its model had “resolved more than 100 long-standing open problems across most areas of mathematics.” The released papers and other details also include some summaries of the model’s reasoning, estimates of the compute used, and stats about the number of problems attempted. OpenAI claims the “average result” used the equivalent of three hours of ChatGPT Pro thinking.

AGMAI, or the Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence, published its first recommendations in late September, urging AI labs to release mathematical results promptly and through established academic channels where possible, while disclosing details such as the name of the model used, prompts, and compute costs. The group also implored AI companies to “refrain from treating the release of mathematical results as marketing vehicles to promote their models,” a practice they said inflicts significant harm on the mathematical community.

Here’s how OpenAI described its process for this release:

For this release, we’re publishing the results in a GitHub repository, with protocols for paper revisions and citations. We’re continuing to explore other community-hosted alternatives for this release which meet the committee’s guidelines. For future releases, we are committed to further improving the quality of the papers via the citations, mathematical exposition, and presentation of the results for better understanding

The full impact of the results will likely take some time to be felt as mathematicians assess and digest them. They add to a rapidly growing body of mathematical results from OpenAI and rival labs like Anthropic that the field is still processing, including results concerning a Millennium Prize problem, among the most famous open questions in the field. The speed at which AI labs have barreled into the discipline this year — particularly their handling of announcements — has provoked fierce debate over research practices, ethics, and how companies credit the human mathematicians whose work their systems build upon and potentially use to produce results.

OpenAI 在一批共 722 篇手稿中公布了由一款未发布的前沿模型得出的诸多长期未决数学问题的解答，涵盖将相关论文归类的 372 个成果族。这延续了一系列突破，这些突破既让数学界部分学者感到惊艳，也引发了他们的不安，同时也对研究伦理和学术行为提出了疑问。据 AGMAI（新成立的由顶尖数学家组成的独立顾问小组，旨在负责任地沟通与传达这些成果）称，此次发布的内容包含“数百个”开放性问题的解答。
各方对这些结果已有数周的预期，尽管此前 OpenAI 尚未提供该模型具体解决了哪些问题以及确切何时公布的细节。今年 9 月，该公司表示其模型已“在绝大多数数学领域解决了 100 多个长期未决的开放问题”。此次发布的论文和其他细节还包括模型推理过程的部分总结、所用算力的估算以及尝试解答问题数量的统计数据。OpenAI 声称，“平均成果”消耗的算力相当于 ChatGPT Pro 思考三小时。
AGMAI，即“数学与人工智能顾问小组”（Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence），于 9 月底发布了首份建议，敦促各大人工智能实验室及时发布数学研究成果，并在可能的情况下通过成熟的学术渠道进行发布，同时披露所用模型名称、提示词和算力成本等细节。该小组还恳请 AI 公司“不要将发布数学成果作为推销其模型的营销手段”，并称这种做法对数学界造成了严重伤害。
以下是 OpenAI 对本次发布流程的说明：
在本次发布中，我们正在一个 GitHub 代码库中公开发布这些结果，并附有论文修订和引用的规范方案。我们正继续探索其他符合委员会指导准则的社区托管替代方案。对于未来的发布，我们致力于通过引用、数学阐述以及为了更好理解而呈现结果的方式，进一步提升论文的质量。
随着数学家们对这些结果进行评估和消化，其全部影响可能还需要一段时间才能完全显现。它们使 OpenAI 以及 Anthropic 等竞争实验室迅速增加的数学成果体量进一步扩大，而该领域目前仍在对这些成果进行消化吸收，其中还包括涉及“千禧年大奖难题”（该领域最著名的未解难题之一）的相关结果。今年各 AI 实验室冲入该学科的速度——特别是他们处理成果发布的方式——引发了一场围绕研究规范、伦理以及企业如何归功于人类数学家的激烈辩论，毕竟 AI 系统的构建及其产生结果所依据的工作正是建立在这些人类数学家的成果之上。

According to AGMAI, the newly formed independent advisory group of elite mathematicians put together to work on communicating the results responsibly, the release includes solutions to “hundreds” of open questions.
OpenAI claims the “average result” used the equivalent of three hours of ChatGPT Pro thinking.

AGMAI, or the Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence, published its first recommendations in late September, urging AI labs to release mathematical results promptly and through established academic channels where possible, while disclosing details such as the name of the model used, prompts, and compute costs.
For this release, we’re publishing the results in a GitHub repository, with protocols for paper revisions and citations.

financeStories.originalTitle: Biodegradable nanoparticle technology may improve agricultural production
financeStories.snippet: Farmers use a manufactured version of a natural plant hormone called gibberellic acid to improve the health and growth of crops, but it is highly sensitive to heat and light. A study in the Journal of the Science of Food and Agriculture shows that loading gibberellic acid into biodegradable nanoparticles can improve grape yield and quality, making it a promising and environmentally friendly approach for sustainable agricultural production.
financeStories.fullContent:
edited by Sadie Harley, reviewed by Robert Egan

This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies. Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

peer-reviewed publication

Farmers use a manufactured version of a natural plant hormone called gibberellic acid to improve the health and growth of crops, but it is highly sensitive to heat and light. A study in the Journal of the Science of Food and Agriculture shows that loading gibberellic acid into biodegradable nanoparticles can improve grape yield and quality, making it a promising and environmentally friendly approach for sustainable agricultural production.

Field applications demonstrated that treatment with gibberellic acid–loaded nanoparticles increased grape cluster weight by 104% and length by 67% compared with free gibberellic acid treatment, while berry weight, length and width increased by 15%, 4% and 13%, respectively.

"Compared to traditional products, nanocarrier systems ensure more efficient delivery of active substances such as plant growth regulators in agricultural applications," the authors wrote.

Polymeric Nano-Delivery of Gibberellic Acid Enhances Fruit Quality, Yield, and Pedicel Strength in Grapevine (Vitis vinifera L.), Journal of the Science of Food and Agriculture (2026). DOI: 10.1002/jsfa.71082

Journal information: Journal of the Science of Food and Agriculture

农民常使用一种名为赤霉酸的天然植物激素的人工合成制剂来改善农作物的健康状况并促进其生长，但这种物质对热和光高度敏感。《食品与农业科学杂志》（Journal of the Science of Food and Agriculture）刊登的一项研究表明，将赤霉酸载入可生物降解的纳米颗粒中可以提高葡萄的产量和品质，使其成为一种极具前景且环境友好的可持续农业生产途径。

田间应用表明，与游离赤霉酸处理相比，经载赤霉酸纳米颗粒处理后，葡萄果穗重增加了104%，果穗长增加了67%，同时单果重、果实长度和果实宽度分别增加了15%、4%和13%。

financeStories.title: 如何查看亚马逊是否认为你“屁股扁平”
financeStories.originalTitle: How to find out if Amazon thinks you have ‘flat buttocks’
financeStories.snippet: "I stumbled upon a page of assumptions that Amazon has made about me based on my purchases and I’m literally speechless," one shopper wrote on Threads.
financeStories.fullContent:
It shouldn’t come as a surprise that Amazon collects data about you based on what you buy. If you buy a lot of cat litter, Amazon will probably infer that you have cats, or if you buy a lot of anti-acne skin products, then Amazon might guess you’re prone to breakouts. Even if we know that Amazon customizes our shopping experiences based on our purchase history, it still comes as a surprise to see all of these personal details laid out in a convenient list. Especially when those details get uncomfortably intimate.

One Threads user came across this section of her Amazon settings where you can see who the shopping giant thinks you are, and alongside more benign assumptions like “Shops from women’s departments” and “Probably owns a Shark robot vacuum,” she found that Amazon assumes she “has flat buttocks.”

“I stumbled upon a page of assumptions that Amazon has made about me based on my purchases and I’m literally speechless,” an Amazon customer, @fangirlinmegan, wrote on Threads. “I mean it ain’t wrong but damn did you have to call me out like that?”

In less than a day, the post garnered over a million views, including many from users who were curious what their own Amazon profiles might reveal. Here’s how you find out.

On desktop, you can find this page by hovering over where Amazon says “Hello, [your name]” in the upper right corner. Then click “Account” under the “Your Account” section. Under the “Ordering and shopping preferences” section, click “Your Shopping preferences.” From here, you can add in information of your own, like your shoe size, interests, and dietary preferences. But we’re not here to tell Amazon that it should stop selling you beef jerky since you’re a vegetarian. We’re here to see if Amazon thinks you have “flat buttocks.” When you scroll to the bottom of the page, you’ll see a blue hyperlinked option that says “Manage your information.” Once you click that, you’ll see what dirt Amazon has on you.

For me, Amazon has gleaned that I am someone who “practices photography,” “plays collectible card games,” and is “invested in the Apple ecosystem.” This is all true. Amazon has even flattered me by noting that I “read diverse non-fiction,” to which I say — why yes, I am indeed an open-minded intellectual with a thirst for knowledge. Thank you for noticing.

Other colleagues of mine found that Amazon correctly noted their interests in vinyl records and ceramics, as well as a penchant for “natural materials” in home decor and clothing that “prioritizes comfort.” None of us had anything as affronting as “has flat buttocks,” but the Threads user noted that this was likely because she had purchased “butt scrunch leggings.”

Tech companies know too much about us, and it’s jarring to realize just how closely they’re paying attention to how we use their platforms. We live in a world of alarming surveillance, but at least I know that Amazon doesn’t think my butt is flat.

When you purchase through links in our articles, we may earn a small commission. This doesn’t affect our editorial independence.

Amanda Silberling is a senior writer at TechCrunch covering the intersection of technology and culture. She has also written for publications like Polygon, MTV, the Kenyon Review, NPR, and Business Insider. She is the co-host of Wow If True, a podcast about internet culture, with science fiction author Isabel J. Kim. Prior to joining TechCrunch, she worked as a grassroots organizer, museum educator, and film festival coordinator. She holds a B.A. in English from the University of Pennsylvania and served as a Princeton in Asia Fellow in Laos.

亚马逊根据你的购买记录收集你的个人数据，这并不令人意外。如果你买了很多猫砂，亚马逊大概会推断你养了猫；如果你买了许多祛痘护肤品，亚马逊可能会猜测你容易长痘。即便我们知道亚马逊会根据购买历史为我们定制购物体验，但看到所有这些个人细节被整理成一份一目了然的清单，依然让人感到吃惊——尤其是当这些细节变得令人尴尬地私密时。

一位 Threads 用户在亚马逊设置中偶然发现了这样一个区域，在这里你可以看到这家电商巨头眼中你是一个怎样的人。除了诸如“在女装部购物”和“可能拥有一台 Shark 扫地机器人”等较为平常的推论外，她还发现亚马逊推测自己“拥有扁平臀部”。

“我偶然发现了一个页面，上面全是亚马逊根据我的购买记录对我做出的推论，我真的无语了，”亚马逊用户 @fangirlinmegan 在 Threads 上写道，“我的意思是，它说得没错，但天哪，你有必要这么当面揭我老底吗？”

在不到一天的时间里，该帖子的浏览量就突破了百万，许多用户都非常好奇自己的亚马逊档案会揭示出什么。以下是查看方法：

在电脑端，你可以将鼠标悬停在页面右上角显示“Hello, [你的名字]”的位置。接着点击“Your Account”（您的账户）下方的“Account”（账户）。在“Ordering and shopping preferences”（订购与购物偏好）部分下，点击“Your Shopping preferences”（您的购物偏好）。在这里，你可以自行添加信息，例如鞋码、兴趣爱好和饮食偏好。但我们来这里并不是为了告诉亚马逊由于你是素食主义者就该停止推荐牛肉干，我们是来看看亚马逊是否认为你“拥有扁平臀部”。当你滚动到页面底部时，会看到一个名为“Manage your information”（管理您的信息）的蓝色超链接选项。点击之后，你就能看到亚马逊掌握了你哪些底细。

对我而言，亚马逊推断出我是一个“热爱摄影”、“玩集换式卡牌游戏”并且“深度融入苹果生态系统”的人。这些全都属实。亚马逊甚至还奉承了我一番，指出我“阅读广泛的非虚构类书籍”，对此我想说——没错，我确实是一位思想开明、求知若渴的知识分子，感谢你的关注。

我的其他同事发现，亚马逊准确记录了他们对黑胶唱片和陶瓷的兴趣，以及在家具装饰中对“天然材质”的偏好和“舒适优先”的着装风格。我们中没有人的标签像“拥有扁平臀部”那样令人难堪，不过那位 Threads 用户指出，这很可能是因为她曾购买过“提臀紧身裤”。

科技公司对我们了解得太多了，意识到它们在如此密切地关注我们如何使用其平台，确实令人不安。我们生活在一个监控无处不在、令人心惊的世界里，但至少我知道亚马逊并不觉得我的屁股是扁的。

当您通过我们文章中的链接购买商品时，我们可能会赚取少量佣金。这不会影响我们的编辑独立性。

Amanda Silberling 是 TechCrunch 的资深撰稿人，报道技术与文化的交叉领域。她还曾为 Polygon、MTV、《凯尼恩评论》、NPR 和《商业内幕》等媒体撰稿。她与科幻作家 Isabel J. Kim 共同主持探讨网络文化的播客《Wow If True》。在加入 TechCrunch 之前，她曾担任基层组织者、博物馆教育工作者和电影节协调员。她拥有宾夕法尼亚大学英语文学学士学位，并曾作为“普林斯顿在亚洲”学者赴老挝交流。

financeStories.fullContent:
This repository contains mathematical manuscripts and supporting proof artifacts produced by an internal OpenAI model.

As part of model development, we evaluate our models on open research problems. We expanded these evaluations after performance on our existing mathematical evaluations saturated. Some outputs build upon earlier results produced by the models.

This collection includes results at different stages of verification. Not all have accompanying Lean formalizations. We will continue to update this repository with Lean formalizations as we obtain them.

Some of the unformalized results could have issues. We will endeavor to fix any such issues quickly. We are also exploring community-hosted repositories for these materials.

The current catalogue contains 722 manuscripts organized into 372 families. A family groups related papers, which may include a principal result, companion arguments, consequences, or alternative proofs. Each family is classified by mathematical discipline.

We are also releasing abridged summaries of the model's reasoning, covering the following results:

The vast majority of results were obtained with the same procedure using an unreleased internal OpenAI model. On average, each result used three hours of ChatGPT Pro thinking compute with that model. Over the course of the evaluation, the model was posed approximately 4,000 problems. Aggregating the output into result families and manuscripts and requiring an appropriate level of significance led to the catalog outlined above.

Exceptions to this fixed procedure include work on a zero-free region for the Riemann zeta function and proof of the Hodge Conjecture for CM abelian varieties. Additionally, the writeup for the Re(s) > 11/12 zero-free region for the Riemann zeta function was human edited for readability.

We will preserve the public release history of this collection. Corrections and revisions will be recorded as new versions, with previously released versions remaining accessible.

To cite the individual manuscript, use the BibTeX block in its directory.

作为模型研发工作的一部分，我们在开放式研究问题上对模型进行了评测。在我们现有的数学基准评测表现达到饱和后，我们扩大了这些评测的范围。部分产出建立在模型先前生成的成果之上。

该合集包含处于不同验证阶段的成果。并非所有成果都附带 Lean 形式化证明。随着我们获得相应的 Lean 形式化成果，我们将持续更新此仓库。

部分尚未形式化的成果可能存在纰漏。我们将努力尽快修复任何此类问题。我们同时也在探索为这些材料设立社区托管的存储库。

当前目录包含 722 篇论文手稿，划分为 372 个成果族（families）。一个成果族将相关论文归并在一起，其中可能包含一项主要成果、配套论证、推论或替代证明。每个成果族均按数学学科门类进行了分类。

我们还发布了模型推理过程的精简摘要，涵盖以下成果：

绝大多数成果均采用相同流程、利用 OpenAI 尚未发布的内部模型获得。平均而言，针对该模型，每个成果耗费了 3 小时的 ChatGPT Pro 思考算力（thinking compute）。在整个评测过程中，模型被提出了大约 4,000 个问题。将输出聚合为成果族和手稿，并筛选出具备相应显著性水平的内容后，便形成了上文所列的目录。

该固定流程的例外情况包括：关于黎曼 zeta 函数无零点区域的研究，以及 CM 阿贝尔簇霍奇猜想（Hodge Conjecture for CM abelian varieties）的证明。此外，关于黎曼 zeta 函数 Re(s) > 11/12 无零点区域的手稿经过了人工编辑以提高可读性。

我们将保留该合集的公开发布历史。更正和修订将记录为新版本，此前发布的版本仍将保持可访问状态。

financeStories.title: 网约车服务除出行功能外或带来公共安全效益
financeStories.originalTitle: Ridesharing services may offer public safety benefits beyond transportation
financeStories.snippet: New research published in Economic Inquiry reveals that ridesharing services like Uber and Lyft may reduce crime in some areas.
financeStories.fullContent:
edited by Sadie Harley, reviewed by Robert Egan

This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies. Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

New research published in Economic Inquiry reveals that ridesharing services like Uber and Lyft may reduce crime in some areas.

Based on data collected during the staggered rollout of ridesharing services in U.S. cities since 2010, the study showed that these services were linked to a 4.6% reduction in the rate of violent crimes, a 5.6% reduction in the rate of property crimes and a 10.5% reduction in the rate of burglaries. No significant effects were observed on larceny, motor vehicle theft or arson.

Improved employment opportunities generated by ridesharing platforms may have played an important role in these crime reductions.

"My findings suggest that digital platforms may generate public safety benefits beyond their primary commercial purpose," said study author Emtiaz Hossain Hritan, Ph.D., of the University of California, Irvine.

"Ridesharing services may complement traditional crime-reduction strategies by improving mobility and expanding employment opportunities."

Crime on the Move? The Effect of Ridesharing Services on Crime, Economic Inquiry (2026). DOI: 10.1111/ecin.70087

由 Sadie Harley 编辑，Robert Egan 审校
本文已按照 Science X 的编辑流程与准则进行审校。编辑在确保内容真实可信的同时突出了以下属性：
发表在《经济探询》（Economic Inquiry）上的一项新研究揭示，优步（Uber）和 Lyft 等网约车服务可能会降低某些地区的犯罪率。
基于 2010 年以来网约车服务在美国各城市分阶段推广期间收集的数据，该研究表明，这些服务与暴力犯罪率下降 4.6%、财产犯罪率下降 5.6% 以及入室盗窃率下降 10.5% 相关。在普通盗窃、机动车盗窃或纵火方面未观察到显著影响。
网约车平台带来的就业机会改善，可能在这些犯罪率的降低中发挥了重要作用。
加利福尼亚大学尔湾分校的研究作者埃姆蒂亚兹·侯赛因·赫里坦（Emtiaz Hossain Hritan）博士表示：“我的研究结果表明，数字平台除了其主要的商业目的外，还可能产生公共安全效益。”
“网约车服务可以通过提高人员流动性并扩大就业机会，对传统的预防和减少犯罪策略起到补充作用。”
《移动中的犯罪？网约车服务对犯罪的影响》（Crime on the Move? The Effect of Ridesharing Services on Crime），《经济探询》（Economic Inquiry，2026）。DOI: 10.1111/ecin.70087

financeStories.originalTitle: US death row inmate Christa Pike awake and speaking after failed execution, lawyers say
financeStories.snippet: Experts and lawyers called the apparent recovery unprecedented, noting she is believed to be the only known person to survive a lethal injection.
financeStories.fullContent:
This video can not be played

Watch: What we know about Christa Pike’s "unprecedented" recovery after failed execution

US death row inmate Christa Pike is "conscious and speaking" after surviving a failed execution attempt in Tennessee last week, her lawyers say.

Pike, 50, continues to receive critical medical care while "handcuffed and shackled to the bed" in hospital, her lawyers said in a statement on Tuesday.

Pike, who was sentenced to death after murdering Colleen Slemmer with her then-boyfriend in 1995, survived two failed lethal injections last Wednesday in Tennessee.

She was taken to hospital, where she remained unconscious for days as medical staff cleared her body of the injected chemical. Experts and her legal team say her apparent recovery is unprecedented.

Pike is believed to be the only person to survive a lethal injection.

Her lawyers said her prognosis remained unclear, but that "at a minimum, we expect a long recovery".

Deborah Denno, a criminologist and professor at Fordham Law School, said she was "absolutely astonished" that Pike was conscious and speaking.

There had been seven other cases where prisoners survived executions but in those cases, executioners were not able to inject anything into the inmates' veins, Denno told the BBC.

Pike "is the only person for whom some kind of toxin has been injected", she said.

"They did everything they were supposed to do as part of the execution process, and it simply didn't work," Denno said. "This has never happened before."

Speaking to Radio 4's Today programme, a local journalist who witnessed the attempted execution said that he, too, did not know of "an exact precedent".

Steven Hale, a journalist for the Nashville Banner, said the case raised many questions, including "what must this be like for the victim's family, who for 30 years has been told we are gonna give you justice and justice is us executing Christa Pike".

What happened in the failed execution of Christa Pike - and what next?

Authorities have not yet said whether they will try again to execute Pike. They have also not offered an explanation for what went wrong after twice injecting her with the chemical pentobarbital.

Tennessee Governor Bill Lee has suspended all executions for the rest of the year - and the head of prisons in the state said over the weekend that he planned to resign.

Pike was 18 when she and her then-boyfriend, Tadaryl Shipp, beat, tortured and killed 19-year-old Slemmer, whom they had met at a job training camp for troubled teens.

Shipp was 17 years old at the time, meaning that he was spared the death penalty for his part in the attack because he was not yet legally an adult at the time. He remains in prison.

Pike's lawyers are scheduled to appear in court in Nashville on Wednesday. They also plan to hold a news conference outside the court.

In their latest update, they repeated their call for Lee to use his powers to commute Pike's sentence to the lower punishment of life in prison without parole.

Colleen Slemmer was tortured and brutally killed by Pike and her then-boyfriend

Dr Joel Zivot, an anaesthesiologist advising Pike's defence team, said on Tuesday that the likelihood of recovering from lethal injection was low.

"Most people who get lethal injection die from it," he told the BBC. "In fact, pretty well everyone, except Christa. So, the fact that she survived it... was unusual."

But there remains a lot of uncertainty and many unknowns, he said, including how much of the pentobarbital got into her system, what her blood levels were after the injection and what her recovery will look like.

"I would not, in any way, say at this point that all the big risks are behind her," he noted.

Zivot had previously said the two doses of pentobarbital she received last week would have been enough that, had it entered her bloodstream in normal circulation, "she would have surely died".

Instead, Zivot said a possible explanation is that instead of entering Pike's bloodstream, the pentobarbital was more likely to have spread across the tissue under her skin.

Pike's lawyers previously warned that her medical history and anatomy - including thrombocytosis (a blood-clotting condition) and small veins - meant there was a risk she would experience "unnecessary" pain and suffering during a lethal injection.

They said on Tuesday that she has endured "severe damage" to her arms.

How widely used is the death penalty in the US?

In 2022, more than a third of executions across the US were botched or highly problematic, according to the Death Penalty Information Center, which tracks information about such cases.

For lethal injections, such incidents have typically occurred due to difficulty obtaining reliable IV access to the veins, though the underlying reason differs from person to person.

In cases the centre has documented, all failures happened before the lethal drugs could be administered. The last failed lethal injection that was tracked happened earlier this year - also in Tennessee.

The execution of Tony Carruthers, who was convicted of kidnapping and murdering three people in 1994, was postponed in May after staff were unable to find a vein for a lethal injection. He was granted a year's reprieve by the governor.

该视频无法播放
观看：关于克丽丝塔·派克在执行死刑失败后“史无前例”的复苏，我们所了解到的情况

律师表示，美国死刑犯克丽丝塔·派克（Christa Pike）上周在田纳西州经历未遂死刑执行并幸存后，目前已“恢复意识并能开口说话”。

其律师在周二的一份声明中表示，现年50岁的派克仍在医院接受危重监护治疗，同时“被戴上手铐并用脚镣铐在病床上”。

派克因在1995年与当时的男友杀害柯琳·斯莱默（Colleen Slemmer）而被判处死刑。上周三，她在田纳西州两次注射死刑失败后幸存。

她被送往医院，在医务人员清除其体内注射的化学药物期间，她连续昏迷了数天。专家及她的法律团队表示，她目前的苏醒表现是史无前例的。

据信，派克是唯一一名在注射死刑中幸存的人。

她的律师表示，其预后情况仍不明朗，但“至少可以预计这将是一段漫长的康复过程”。

福特汉姆大学法学院犯罪学家兼教授德博拉·丹诺（Deborah Denno）表示，派克恢复意识并能说话让她感到“极其震惊”。

丹诺向英国广播公司（BBC）表示，此前曾有另外7起囚犯在死刑执行中幸存的案例，但那些情况都是行刑人员根本未能将任何药物注射进囚犯的静脉。

她说，派克“是唯一一名体内已被注入了某种毒素的人”。

“他们执行了死刑程序中要求的一切步骤，但它就是没有起效，”丹诺说。“这在以前从未发生过。”

一名目睹了这次死刑执行未遂过程的当地记者在接受BBC广播四台《今日》节目采访时表示，他同样不知道有“任何确切的前例”。

《纳什维尔旗帜报》（Nashville Banner）记者史蒂文·黑尔（Steven Hale）表示，该案引发了诸多疑问，包括“对于受害者家属来说这得是什么滋味——他们30年来一直被告知‘我们会还你们正义，而正义就是处决克丽丝塔·派克’”。

克丽丝塔·派克的死刑执行失败过程究竟发生了什么——接下来又会怎样？

有关部门尚未说明是否会再次尝试对派克执行死刑。他们也未对在两次向其注射化学药物戊巴比妥后究竟出了什么差错作出解释。

田纳西州州长比尔·李（Bill Lee）已暂停今年剩余时间内的所有死刑执行——而该州监狱部门主管也在周末表示计划辞职。

派克当年18岁，她和当时17岁的男友塔达里尔·希普（Tadaryl Shipp）在一家针对问题青少年的就业培训营中结识了19岁的斯莱默，随后对其实施殴打、折磨并将其杀害。

希普当时年仅17岁，这意味着由于案发时在法律上未成年，他因在袭击中的罪行免于被判死刑。目前他仍在服刑。

派克的律师定于周三在纳什维尔出庭。他们还计划在法院外举行新闻发布会。

在最新声明中，他们重申了呼吁州长李行使其权力，将派克的刑罚减为不得假释的终身监禁。

柯琳·斯莱默遭到派克及其当时的男友折磨并残忍杀害

为派克辩护团队提供咨询的麻醉科医生乔尔·齐沃特（Dr Joel Zivot）周二表示，从注射死刑中恢复的可能性极低。

“绝大多数接受注射死刑的人都会因此死亡，”他告诉BBC。“事实上，几乎所有人都是如此，唯独克丽丝塔除外。因此，她能够幸存……是极为罕见的。”

但他说，目前仍存在许多不确定性和未知数，包括究竟有多少戊巴比妥进入了她的体内系统、注射后她血液中的药物浓度是多少，以及她的康复过程会是怎样。

“在目前阶段，我绝不会认为所有的巨大风险都已过去，”他指出。

齐沃特此前曾表示，她上周接受的两剂戊巴比妥剂量，如果进入其血液并正常循环，“她必死无疑”。

相反，齐沃特表示，一个可能的解释是，戊巴比妥并没有进入派克的血液循环，而更有可能是扩散到了她的皮下组织中。

派克的律师此前曾警告称，她的病史和身体解剖结构——包括血小板增多症（一种凝血疾病）和细小的静脉——意味着她在接受注射死刑时存在遭受“不必要”痛苦与折磨的风险。

他们周二表示，她的双臂遭受了“严重损伤”。

死刑在美国的使用范围有多广？

据跟踪此类案件信息的死刑信息中心（Death Penalty Information Center）统计，2022年全美超过三分之一的死刑执行出现了重大失误或严重问题。

就注射死刑而言，此类事件通常是因为难以在静脉上建立可靠的静脉注射通道而发生的，尽管具体的深层原因因人而异。

在该中心记录的案例中，所有失败均发生在致死药物被注入之前。此前记录到的最后一起注射死刑失败案例发生在今年早些时候——同样是在田纳西州。

托尼·卡拉瑟斯（Tony Carruthers）因1994年绑架并谋杀3人被定罪，今年5月，因工作人员无法为其注射死刑找到静脉，其死刑执行被推迟。他获得了州长给予的一年缓刑。

我20年前采访过克丽丝塔·派克——我至今无法停止想起她

financeStories.originalTitle: Apple is reportedly partnering with LG to launch a smart lock, thermostat, and doorbell
financeStories.snippet: Apple appears poised to push into the smart home market with a slate of new devices and a key partner.
financeStories.fullContent:
Apple is working on a new ecosystem of smart home devices via a partnership with LG, Bloomberg has reported.

The new devices — which include a smart lock, a thermostat, and a doorbell — are designed to integrate with the company’s smart home hub, another upcoming product that will reportedly launch on October 13. That hub is expected to include a 6-inch square display that can be placed on a countertop or mounted on a wall.

The two companies are also working on a slate of security cameras, including models for indoor and outdoor, was well as a floodlight. The LG devices are expected to be announced, if not formally released, next week, too. TechCrunch reached out to Apple for more information.

Interestingly, the devices will reportedly carry the LG brand — despite being developed by both companies.

The new products could aptly be read as a swipe at Amazon’s smart home offerings, which currently include a variety of similar products, including its Ring home security cameras.

Apple has sought to push into new territory with its recent hardware releases. One of those new territories is an expanded smart home presence.

financeStories.title: 前Ramp工程师在推翻首款产品后，为其新平台Melius筹集2000万美元
financeStories.originalTitle: Ex-Ramp engineers raise $20M for platform Melius after scrapping their first product
financeStories.snippet: Instead of helping marketers manage and optimize ad spend, the company is focusing on building the tools that generate the creative assets and campaigns.
financeStories.fullContent:
Melius, an AI platform for generating ad campaigns, images, and videos, announced on Tuesday that it raised a total of $25 million in funding, including a $20 million Series A led by CRV and a $5 million seed round led by General Catalyst.

While the startup claims to have hit more than $1 million in annualized revenue within two months of coming out of stealth in July, co-founder Joowon Kim (pictured on right) admits that Melius didn’t hit it out of the park initially.

When the New York-based company first launched over a year ago, Kim and his co-founders, Young Kim (pictured on left) and Arnav Ramu (pictured center) set out to build an AI-powered performance marketing tool. The three knew each other from working as engineers at Ramp, the corporate spending and finance software company.

More than six months after building the product, the co-founders decided their original idea didn’t “have legs,” Joowon Kim told TechCrunch.

Instead of helping marketers manage and optimize ad spend, the team chose to focus on what it saw as a much larger opportunity: building the tools that generate the creative assets and campaigns themselves.

“We scrapped the entire codebase; we burned all of it,” Kim said. Melius quickly went to work on an entirely new product. Nearly a year after its initial launch, it revealed a platform that it describes as an “agents lab for creative work.”

Melius is far from the only startup helping ad agencies, marketers, and brands generate creative assets and campaigns with AI. Competitors include rapidly growing Higgsfield, which was valued at $5.4 billion in August, as well as other small startups, including Krea and Flora AI.

Kim isn’t concerned about the competition.

He acknowledged that Higgsfield, a three-year-old company that has hit over $700 million in annualized revenue, “is growing like mad,” but according to Kim, the size of the market is so large that it can support multiple competitors.

“There are a lot of players, which is pretty exciting,” he told TechCrunch. “That means there are customers to be won and there is demand in this space.”

As for why former Ramp engineers are building an ad-generation product, Kim, who describes himself as a social media influencer, says he has been passionate about making short videos since elementary school and once dreamed of becoming a famous YouTuber.

“I tried my best to make vlogs,” he said. “My dad was great at using FinalCut Pro, but I wasn’t.”

Those early vlogs never quite took off, but his fascination with making digital media remained.

Now, with Melius, he’s building the tool he always wanted: a platform where anyone, including seasoned creative directors, can turn their ideas into reality using plain language.

用于生成广告活动、图像和视频的AI平台Melius于周二宣布，公司已累计完成2500万美元融资，其中包括由CRV领投的2000万美元A轮融资，以及由General Catalyst领投的500万美元种子轮融资。

尽管这家初创公司声称在7月结束隐形模式（stealth mode）后的两个月内，年化收入已突破100万美元，但联合创始人Joowon Kim（右图）坦言，Melius最初并未一鸣惊人。

一年多前，这家总部位于纽约的公司刚成立时，Kim与其联合创始人Young Kim（左图）和Arnav Ramu（中图）打算打造一款由AI驱动的效果营销工具。三人此前均在企业支出与财务软件公司Ramp担任工程师，并在那里结识。

Joowon Kim告诉TechCrunch，在开发该产品六个多月后，联合创始人们认为原有的想法“走不通”。

该团队没有选择继续帮助营销人员管理和优化广告支出，而是将精力投向了他们认为更为广阔的机遇：打造直接生成创意素材和广告活动本身的工具。

“我们废弃了全部代码库；彻底付之一炬，”Kim说。Melius迅速着手研发一款全新产品。在其初次亮相近一年后，团队推出了一款被其称为“创意工作智能体实验室”（agents lab for creative work）的平台。

Melius远非唯一一家利用AI帮助广告代理商、营销人员和品牌生成创意素材及广告活动的初创公司。其竞争对手包括增长迅猛、于8月份估值达54亿美元的Higgsfield，以及Krea和Flora AI等其他小型初创公司。

Kim对行业竞争并不感到担忧。

他承认，成立三年的Higgsfield年化收入已超过7000万美元，“增长势头极其迅猛”，但Kim认为，该市场的体量足够大，足以容纳多家竞争对手。

“赛道中有很多参与者，这非常令人兴奋，”他向TechCrunch表示。“这意味着有客户等待争取，而且这个领域存在真实需求。”

至于前Ramp工程师为何会转向开发广告生成产品，自称为社交媒体网红的Kim表示，他从小学起就对制作短视频充满热情，甚至曾梦想成为一名知名YouTuber。

“我曾竭尽全力制作vlog，”他说。“我父亲非常擅长使用FinalCut Pro，但我却不太行。”

那些早期的vlog虽然从未真正走红，但他对制作数字媒体的热情始终未减。

如今，借助Melius，他正在打造自己一直梦寐以求的工具：一个让任何人——包括资深创意总监——都能通过普通自然语言将自己的创意变为现实的平台。

financeStories.fullContent:
Posts from this topic will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

The streaming rights come in November, when Microsoft is opening up access to Xbox Cloud Gaming.

Posts from this author will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

See All by Tom Warren

Xbox CEO Asha Sharma told employees that Microsoft is getting ready to do something around Grand Theft Auto VI that “no other platform holder is doing” during an employee all-hands this morning. According to sources familiar with Microsoft’s plans, Sharma’s brief teaser was actually about Xbox managing to land a deal for game streaming rights for Grand Theft Auto VI.

The deal will mean Xbox Cloud Gaming can stream Grand Theft Auto VI to players at launch, but it’s not clear how long the agreement will be in place. Rockstar Games still hasn’t announced a PC version of Grand Theft Auto VI, and a streaming deal would normally also allow Xbox to market its Xbox Cloud Gaming service to PC players who would otherwise need an Xbox Series X / S or PS5 console.

After The Verge originally reported that the deal would be exclusive, Xbox chief strategy officer Matthew Ball revealed on X that Microsoft wouldn’t be streaming Grand Theft Auto VI exclusively, nor to PCs. That suggests the deal is simply for Xbox console streaming, and may mean the web browsers and apps that can usually access Xbox Cloud Gaming will not be able to stream Grand Theft Auto VI.

Microsoft is also opening up access to Xbox Cloud Gaming with a pay-as-you-go option next month, rather than being limited to Game Pass subscriptions. The pay-as-you-go option is perfectly timed for Grand Theft Auto VI, allowing those who don’t own an Xbox, or who primarily play from a phone, to stream the game by paying for a bundle of hours.

During the Xbox all-hands, Sharma also told employees that Project Helix, the next generation of Xbox hardware, will be a “family of devices” and that Microsoft will partner with others on some of those devices. Sharma first called Helix a family of devices last month in an interview, after Microsoft and AMD announced a “strategic multi-year partnership” last year to work together on “a portfolio of devices,” including Microsoft’s next-generation Xbox console.

Correction, October 6th: Xbox has clarified that its streaming deal isn’t exclusive and Grand Theft Auto VI won’t be streamed to PCs.

Xbox首席执行官阿莎·夏尔马（Asha Sharma）在今天上午的全员大会上向员工表示，微软正准备围绕《侠盗猎车手6》（Grand Theft Auto VI）做一些“其他平台持有者都没有做过的事情”。据熟悉微软计划的知情人士透露，夏尔马的简短预告实际上是指Xbox成功达成了《侠盗猎车手6》的游戏串流权益协议。

该协议意味着Xbox Cloud Gaming在游戏发售时即可向玩家串流《侠盗猎车手6》，但目前尚不清楚该协议的有效期有多长。Rockstar Games仍未公布《侠盗猎车手6》的PC版本，而串流协议通常也会让Xbox能够向原本需要Xbox Series X / S或PS5主机的PC玩家推广其Xbox Cloud Gaming服务。

在The Verge最初报道该协议具有独占性后，Xbox首席战略官马修·鲍尔（Matthew Ball）在X平台上透露，微软不会独家串流《侠盗猎车手6》，也不会串流至PC。这表明该协议仅针对Xbox主机串流，并可能意味着通常可以访问Xbox Cloud Gaming的网页浏览器和应用程序将无法串流《侠盗猎车手6》。

微软下个月还将开放Xbox Cloud Gaming的按需付费（pay-as-you-go）选项，而不再仅限于Game Pass订阅。按需付费选项的推出时间与《侠盗猎车手6》的节奏完美契合，让那些没有Xbox主机或主要通过手机玩游戏的玩家能够通过购买时长套餐来串流游玩该游戏。

在Xbox全员大会期间，夏尔马还告诉员工，下一代Xbox硬件“Helix项目”（Project Helix）将是一个“设备家族”，微软将在其中部分设备上与其他厂商合作。夏尔马在上个月的一次采访中首次将Helix称为设备家族；在此之前，微软与AMD于去年宣布达成“多年战略合作伙伴关系”，共同开发包括微软下一代Xbox主机在内的“设备产品组合”。

更正，10月6日：Xbox已澄清其串流协议并非独占，且《侠盗猎车手6》不会串流至PC平台。

aiStories.originalTitle: Spotify expands audiobooks to over 180 markets
aiStories.snippet: Spotify will make 350,000 titles available in over 120 languages for this expansion
aiStories.fullContent:
Spotify announced on Wednesday that it’s expanding audiobook access to over 180 markets worldwide, including regions across Europe, the Americas, the Caribbean, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia. The rollout is starting today and will continue over the coming months. With this move, more than 750 million users will be able to access audiobooks, allowing Spotify to better compete with both music streaming providers and audiobook apps like Audible.

Before this, audiobooks were available primarily in English-speaking markets like the U.S., U.K., Ireland, Australia, and New Zealand, as well as in Germany.

The audio platform said it has more than 350,000 titles for its new markets and has increased its collection to include over 120 languages. With its launch in Spain, users in the country will have access to over 45,000 titles in Spanish.

Spotify is working with more than 300 publishers worldwide, including Planeta and Mondadori, to increase the number of titles available in different markets.

With a Premium subscription, users can listen to 12 hours of audiobooks in eligible countries such as Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Poland, Chile, Norway, and Peru. People across the world can also purchase an Audiobook+ standalone subscription to get access to titles with a 15-hour allowance. Alternatively, users can buy individual titles directly.

In February, the company launched a “Page Match” feature, which lets users scan a page of a physical book and find the corresponding point in the audiobook to listen to. Since the launch, 1 million people have been using the feature monthly, the company noted.

Spotify said that over the last year, monthly listeners of audiobooks grew by 40% and listening hours increased by 30%.

This year, the company introduced Audiobook Charts to let people discover popular titles. It also launched an AI-powered tool for authors to turn their books into audiobooks using models from ElevenLabs. Plus, Spotify started experimenting with physical sales of books through its audiobook platform in select markets like the U.S. and the U.K.

Posts from this topic will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

Solutions to ‘hundreds’ of open questions are said to be included in a batch of manuscripts released by OpenAI.

Posts from this author will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

See All by Robert Hart

OpenAI has revealed solutions to a number of long-standing mathematics problems produced by an unreleased frontier model in a batch of 722 manuscripts, covering 372 result families that group related papers. It extends a run of breakthroughs that have both impressed and unsettled parts of the mathematical community while raising questions about research ethics and academic conduct. According to AGMAI, the newly formed independent advisory group of elite mathematicians put together to work on communicating the results responsibly, the release includes solutions to “hundreds” of open questions.

The results have been expected for weeks, although until now OpenAI had not provided details about which problems the model had solved or exactly when they would be published. In September, the company said its model had “resolved more than 100 long-standing open problems across most areas of mathematics.” The released papers and other details also include some summaries of the model’s reasoning, estimates of the compute used, and stats about the number of problems attempted. OpenAI claims the “average result” used the equivalent of three hours of ChatGPT Pro thinking.

AGMAI, or the Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence, published its first recommendations in late September, urging AI labs to release mathematical results promptly and through established academic channels where possible, while disclosing details such as the name of the model used, prompts, and compute costs. The group also implored AI companies to “refrain from treating the release of mathematical results as marketing vehicles to promote their models,” a practice they said inflicts significant harm on the mathematical community.

Here’s how OpenAI described its process for this release:

For this release, we’re publishing the results in a GitHub repository, with protocols for paper revisions and citations. We’re continuing to explore other community-hosted alternatives for this release which meet the committee’s guidelines. For future releases, we are committed to further improving the quality of the papers via the citations, mathematical exposition, and presentation of the results for better understanding

The full impact of the results will likely take some time to be felt as mathematicians assess and digest them. They add to a rapidly growing body of mathematical results from OpenAI and rival labs like Anthropic that the field is still processing, including results concerning a Millennium Prize problem, among the most famous open questions in the field. The speed at which AI labs have barreled into the discipline this year — particularly their handling of announcements — has provoked fierce debate over research practices, ethics, and how companies credit the human mathematicians whose work their systems build upon and potentially use to produce results.

OpenAI 在一批共 722 篇手稿中公布了由一款未发布的前沿模型得出的诸多长期未决数学问题的解答，涵盖将相关论文归类的 372 个成果族。这延续了一系列突破，这些突破既让数学界部分学者感到惊艳，也引发了他们的不安，同时也对研究伦理和学术行为提出了疑问。据 AGMAI（新成立的由顶尖数学家组成的独立顾问小组，旨在负责任地沟通与传达这些成果）称，此次发布的内容包含“数百个”开放性问题的解答。
各方对这些结果已有数周的预期，尽管此前 OpenAI 尚未提供该模型具体解决了哪些问题以及确切何时公布的细节。今年 9 月，该公司表示其模型已“在绝大多数数学领域解决了 100 多个长期未决的开放问题”。此次发布的论文和其他细节还包括模型推理过程的部分总结、所用算力的估算以及尝试解答问题数量的统计数据。OpenAI 声称，“平均成果”消耗的算力相当于 ChatGPT Pro 思考三小时。
AGMAI，即“数学与人工智能顾问小组”（Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence），于 9 月底发布了首份建议，敦促各大人工智能实验室及时发布数学研究成果，并在可能的情况下通过成熟的学术渠道进行发布，同时披露所用模型名称、提示词和算力成本等细节。该小组还恳请 AI 公司“不要将发布数学成果作为推销其模型的营销手段”，并称这种做法对数学界造成了严重伤害。
以下是 OpenAI 对本次发布流程的说明：
在本次发布中，我们正在一个 GitHub 代码库中公开发布这些结果，并附有论文修订和引用的规范方案。我们正继续探索其他符合委员会指导准则的社区托管替代方案。对于未来的发布，我们致力于通过引用、数学阐述以及为了更好理解而呈现结果的方式，进一步提升论文的质量。
随着数学家们对这些结果进行评估和消化，其全部影响可能还需要一段时间才能完全显现。它们使 OpenAI 以及 Anthropic 等竞争实验室迅速增加的数学成果体量进一步扩大，而该领域目前仍在对这些成果进行消化吸收，其中还包括涉及“千禧年大奖难题”（该领域最著名的未解难题之一）的相关结果。今年各 AI 实验室冲入该学科的速度——特别是他们处理成果发布的方式——引发了一场围绕研究规范、伦理以及企业如何归功于人类数学家的激烈辩论，毕竟 AI 系统的构建及其产生结果所依据的工作正是建立在这些人类数学家的成果之上。

AGMAI, or the Advisory Group on Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence, published its first recommendations in late September, urging AI labs to release mathematical results promptly and through established academic channels where possible, while disclosing details such as the name of the model used, prompts, and compute costs.
For this release, we’re publishing the results in a GitHub repository, with protocols for paper revisions and citations.

aiStories.originalTitle: How to find out if Amazon thinks you have ‘flat buttocks’
aiStories.snippet: "I stumbled upon a page of assumptions that Amazon has made about me based on my purchases and I’m literally speechless," one shopper wrote on Threads.
aiStories.fullContent:
It shouldn’t come as a surprise that Amazon collects data about you based on what you buy. If you buy a lot of cat litter, Amazon will probably infer that you have cats, or if you buy a lot of anti-acne skin products, then Amazon might guess you’re prone to breakouts. Even if we know that Amazon customizes our shopping experiences based on our purchase history, it still comes as a surprise to see all of these personal details laid out in a convenient list. Especially when those details get uncomfortably intimate.

One Threads user came across this section of her Amazon settings where you can see who the shopping giant thinks you are, and alongside more benign assumptions like “Shops from women’s departments” and “Probably owns a Shark robot vacuum,” she found that Amazon assumes she “has flat buttocks.”

“I stumbled upon a page of assumptions that Amazon has made about me based on my purchases and I’m literally speechless,” an Amazon customer, @fangirlinmegan, wrote on Threads. “I mean it ain’t wrong but damn did you have to call me out like that?”

In less than a day, the post garnered over a million views, including many from users who were curious what their own Amazon profiles might reveal. Here’s how you find out.

On desktop, you can find this page by hovering over where Amazon says “Hello, [your name]” in the upper right corner. Then click “Account” under the “Your Account” section. Under the “Ordering and shopping preferences” section, click “Your Shopping preferences.” From here, you can add in information of your own, like your shoe size, interests, and dietary preferences. But we’re not here to tell Amazon that it should stop selling you beef jerky since you’re a vegetarian. We’re here to see if Amazon thinks you have “flat buttocks.” When you scroll to the bottom of the page, you’ll see a blue hyperlinked option that says “Manage your information.” Once you click that, you’ll see what dirt Amazon has on you.

For me, Amazon has gleaned that I am someone who “practices photography,” “plays collectible card games,” and is “invested in the Apple ecosystem.” This is all true. Amazon has even flattered me by noting that I “read diverse non-fiction,” to which I say — why yes, I am indeed an open-minded intellectual with a thirst for knowledge. Thank you for noticing.

Other colleagues of mine found that Amazon correctly noted their interests in vinyl records and ceramics, as well as a penchant for “natural materials” in home decor and clothing that “prioritizes comfort.” None of us had anything as affronting as “has flat buttocks,” but the Threads user noted that this was likely because she had purchased “butt scrunch leggings.”

Tech companies know too much about us, and it’s jarring to realize just how closely they’re paying attention to how we use their platforms. We live in a world of alarming surveillance, but at least I know that Amazon doesn’t think my butt is flat.

aiStories.originalTitle: Apple is reportedly partnering with LG to launch a smart lock, thermostat, and doorbell
aiStories.snippet: Apple appears poised to push into the smart home market with a slate of new devices and a key partner.
aiStories.fullContent:
Apple is working on a new ecosystem of smart home devices via a partnership with LG, Bloomberg has reported.

The new devices — which include a smart lock, a thermostat, and a doorbell — are designed to integrate with the company’s smart home hub, another upcoming product that will reportedly launch on October 13. That hub is expected to include a 6-inch square display that can be placed on a countertop or mounted on a wall.

The two companies are also working on a slate of security cameras, including models for indoor and outdoor, was well as a floodlight. The LG devices are expected to be announced, if not formally released, next week, too. TechCrunch reached out to Apple for more information.

Interestingly, the devices will reportedly carry the LG brand — despite being developed by both companies.

The new products could aptly be read as a swipe at Amazon’s smart home offerings, which currently include a variety of similar products, including its Ring home security cameras.

Apple has sought to push into new territory with its recent hardware releases. One of those new territories is an expanded smart home presence.

aiStories.title: 前Ramp工程师在推翻首款产品后，为其新平台Melius筹集2000万美元
aiStories.originalTitle: Ex-Ramp engineers raise $20M for platform Melius after scrapping their first product
aiStories.snippet: Instead of helping marketers manage and optimize ad spend, the company is focusing on building the tools that generate the creative assets and campaigns.
aiStories.fullContent:
Melius, an AI platform for generating ad campaigns, images, and videos, announced on Tuesday that it raised a total of $25 million in funding, including a $20 million Series A led by CRV and a $5 million seed round led by General Catalyst.

While the startup claims to have hit more than $1 million in annualized revenue within two months of coming out of stealth in July, co-founder Joowon Kim (pictured on right) admits that Melius didn’t hit it out of the park initially.

When the New York-based company first launched over a year ago, Kim and his co-founders, Young Kim (pictured on left) and Arnav Ramu (pictured center) set out to build an AI-powered performance marketing tool. The three knew each other from working as engineers at Ramp, the corporate spending and finance software company.

More than six months after building the product, the co-founders decided their original idea didn’t “have legs,” Joowon Kim told TechCrunch.

Instead of helping marketers manage and optimize ad spend, the team chose to focus on what it saw as a much larger opportunity: building the tools that generate the creative assets and campaigns themselves.

“We scrapped the entire codebase; we burned all of it,” Kim said. Melius quickly went to work on an entirely new product. Nearly a year after its initial launch, it revealed a platform that it describes as an “agents lab for creative work.”

Melius is far from the only startup helping ad agencies, marketers, and brands generate creative assets and campaigns with AI. Competitors include rapidly growing Higgsfield, which was valued at $5.4 billion in August, as well as other small startups, including Krea and Flora AI.

Kim isn’t concerned about the competition.

He acknowledged that Higgsfield, a three-year-old company that has hit over $700 million in annualized revenue, “is growing like mad,” but according to Kim, the size of the market is so large that it can support multiple competitors.

“There are a lot of players, which is pretty exciting,” he told TechCrunch. “That means there are customers to be won and there is demand in this space.”

As for why former Ramp engineers are building an ad-generation product, Kim, who describes himself as a social media influencer, says he has been passionate about making short videos since elementary school and once dreamed of becoming a famous YouTuber.

“I tried my best to make vlogs,” he said. “My dad was great at using FinalCut Pro, but I wasn’t.”

Those early vlogs never quite took off, but his fascination with making digital media remained.

Now, with Melius, he’s building the tool he always wanted: a platform where anyone, including seasoned creative directors, can turn their ideas into reality using plain language.

用于生成广告活动、图像和视频的AI平台Melius于周二宣布，公司已累计完成2500万美元融资，其中包括由CRV领投的2000万美元A轮融资，以及由General Catalyst领投的500万美元种子轮融资。

尽管这家初创公司声称在7月结束隐形模式（stealth mode）后的两个月内，年化收入已突破100万美元，但联合创始人Joowon Kim（右图）坦言，Melius最初并未一鸣惊人。

一年多前，这家总部位于纽约的公司刚成立时，Kim与其联合创始人Young Kim（左图）和Arnav Ramu（中图）打算打造一款由AI驱动的效果营销工具。三人此前均在企业支出与财务软件公司Ramp担任工程师，并在那里结识。

Joowon Kim告诉TechCrunch，在开发该产品六个多月后，联合创始人们认为原有的想法“走不通”。

该团队没有选择继续帮助营销人员管理和优化广告支出，而是将精力投向了他们认为更为广阔的机遇：打造直接生成创意素材和广告活动本身的工具。

“我们废弃了全部代码库；彻底付之一炬，”Kim说。Melius迅速着手研发一款全新产品。在其初次亮相近一年后，团队推出了一款被其称为“创意工作智能体实验室”（agents lab for creative work）的平台。

Melius远非唯一一家利用AI帮助广告代理商、营销人员和品牌生成创意素材及广告活动的初创公司。其竞争对手包括增长迅猛、于8月份估值达54亿美元的Higgsfield，以及Krea和Flora AI等其他小型初创公司。

Kim对行业竞争并不感到担忧。

他承认，成立三年的Higgsfield年化收入已超过7000万美元，“增长势头极其迅猛”，但Kim认为，该市场的体量足够大，足以容纳多家竞争对手。

“赛道中有很多参与者，这非常令人兴奋，”他向TechCrunch表示。“这意味着有客户等待争取，而且这个领域存在真实需求。”

至于前Ramp工程师为何会转向开发广告生成产品，自称为社交媒体网红的Kim表示，他从小学起就对制作短视频充满热情，甚至曾梦想成为一名知名YouTuber。

“我曾竭尽全力制作vlog，”他说。“我父亲非常擅长使用FinalCut Pro，但我却不太行。”

那些早期的vlog虽然从未真正走红，但他对制作数字媒体的热情始终未减。

如今，借助Melius，他正在打造自己一直梦寐以求的工具：一个让任何人——包括资深创意总监——都能通过普通自然语言将自己的创意变为现实的平台。

aiStories.fullContent:
Posts from this topic will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

The streaming rights come in November, when Microsoft is opening up access to Xbox Cloud Gaming.

Posts from this author will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

See All by Tom Warren

Xbox CEO Asha Sharma told employees that Microsoft is getting ready to do something around Grand Theft Auto VI that “no other platform holder is doing” during an employee all-hands this morning. According to sources familiar with Microsoft’s plans, Sharma’s brief teaser was actually about Xbox managing to land a deal for game streaming rights for Grand Theft Auto VI.

The deal will mean Xbox Cloud Gaming can stream Grand Theft Auto VI to players at launch, but it’s not clear how long the agreement will be in place. Rockstar Games still hasn’t announced a PC version of Grand Theft Auto VI, and a streaming deal would normally also allow Xbox to market its Xbox Cloud Gaming service to PC players who would otherwise need an Xbox Series X / S or PS5 console.

After The Verge originally reported that the deal would be exclusive, Xbox chief strategy officer Matthew Ball revealed on X that Microsoft wouldn’t be streaming Grand Theft Auto VI exclusively, nor to PCs. That suggests the deal is simply for Xbox console streaming, and may mean the web browsers and apps that can usually access Xbox Cloud Gaming will not be able to stream Grand Theft Auto VI.

Microsoft is also opening up access to Xbox Cloud Gaming with a pay-as-you-go option next month, rather than being limited to Game Pass subscriptions. The pay-as-you-go option is perfectly timed for Grand Theft Auto VI, allowing those who don’t own an Xbox, or who primarily play from a phone, to stream the game by paying for a bundle of hours.

During the Xbox all-hands, Sharma also told employees that Project Helix, the next generation of Xbox hardware, will be a “family of devices” and that Microsoft will partner with others on some of those devices. Sharma first called Helix a family of devices last month in an interview, after Microsoft and AMD announced a “strategic multi-year partnership” last year to work together on “a portfolio of devices,” including Microsoft’s next-generation Xbox console.

Correction, October 6th: Xbox has clarified that its streaming deal isn’t exclusive and Grand Theft Auto VI won’t be streamed to PCs.

Xbox首席执行官阿莎·夏尔马（Asha Sharma）在今天上午的全员大会上向员工表示，微软正准备围绕《侠盗猎车手6》（Grand Theft Auto VI）做一些“其他平台持有者都没有做过的事情”。据熟悉微软计划的知情人士透露，夏尔马的简短预告实际上是指Xbox成功达成了《侠盗猎车手6》的游戏串流权益协议。

该协议意味着Xbox Cloud Gaming在游戏发售时即可向玩家串流《侠盗猎车手6》，但目前尚不清楚该协议的有效期有多长。Rockstar Games仍未公布《侠盗猎车手6》的PC版本，而串流协议通常也会让Xbox能够向原本需要Xbox Series X / S或PS5主机的PC玩家推广其Xbox Cloud Gaming服务。

在The Verge最初报道该协议具有独占性后，Xbox首席战略官马修·鲍尔（Matthew Ball）在X平台上透露，微软不会独家串流《侠盗猎车手6》，也不会串流至PC。这表明该协议仅针对Xbox主机串流，并可能意味着通常可以访问Xbox Cloud Gaming的网页浏览器和应用程序将无法串流《侠盗猎车手6》。

微软下个月还将开放Xbox Cloud Gaming的按需付费（pay-as-you-go）选项，而不再仅限于Game Pass订阅。按需付费选项的推出时间与《侠盗猎车手6》的节奏完美契合，让那些没有Xbox主机或主要通过手机玩游戏的玩家能够通过购买时长套餐来串流游玩该游戏。

在Xbox全员大会期间，夏尔马还告诉员工，下一代Xbox硬件“Helix项目”（Project Helix）将是一个“设备家族”，微软将在其中部分设备上与其他厂商合作。夏尔马在上个月的一次采访中首次将Helix称为设备家族；在此之前，微软与AMD于去年宣布达成“多年战略合作伙伴关系”，共同开发包括微软下一代Xbox主机在内的“设备产品组合”。

更正，10月6日：Xbox已澄清其串流协议并非独占，且《侠盗猎车手6》不会串流至PC平台。

Comedian Sebastian Maniscalco is facing backlash from fellow comics who claim his takeover of SiriusXM’s Raw Comedy channel is harming up-and-coming talent, as reported earlier by Deadline. Many established comics, including Patton Oswalt and Margaret Cho, have posted videos online calling on Maniscalco to carry on Raw Comedy’s legacy by highlighting newer comedians on his channel, instead of mostly focusing on well-known ones.

SiriusXM launched Sebastian Maniscalco’s Comedy Radio in April, which is “curated and headlined by Sebastian himself,” according to the satellite radio provider. The move replaced SiriusXM’s long-running Raw Comedy channel featuring uncensored stand-up comedy shows from a range of talent. Now, the channel airs Maniscalco’s own show, alongside a stream of stand-up content that comedian Dan Soder says features “very famous comics who are dead or who don’t necessarily need the money.”

The widespread criticism comes as Stand Up for Standup, a nonprofit organization that provides resources for comedians in need, published a report about the channel’s shift away from emerging talent, who rely not only on the visibility they receive from appearing on the station, but also on the royalties they earn from SiriusXM. The organization says that since March, the spins on Maniscalco’s channels have decreased from a wider net of more than 800 comics to a much narrower pool of 275 artists, largely skewed toward celebrities.

“We believe this shift, both in the overall quantity of artists enjoying plays on Channel 102, and the change in distribution across all spin-getters favoring the top few, is bad for comedians, and bad for the future of comedy,” Stand Up for Standup says.

“There’s a lot of up-and-coming comedians who are depending on the money and the checks that they get from Sirius,” Oswalt says in an Instagram video. “But 500 of them have been booted off of Sirius… You can easily reverse this decision. Get those young comedians back on the Sirius channel. Let them get those checks.” Many other comedians, including Liz Miele, Kyle Kinane, and Michelle Wolf, have called out Maniscalco as well.

In a statement to Deadline, SiriusXM says Maniscalco’s channel “introduced a new creative direction and a regularly evolving programming mix for the channel,” adding that “SiriusXM continues to invest in comedians more than any other audio platform.” Neither SiriusXM nor representatives for Maniscalco immediately responded to The Verge’s request for comment.
